g.text: No single chart answers every question.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #647683

g.text: Winning-set memberships for each implemented task: all 13 familiar families are visible.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183445

g.text: Number = cases in the winning set. 0 = tested, but no wins. — = no implemented task contract.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #647683

g.text: Ties are retained, so a column can sum above n. Counts depend on the decoder and setting.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #647683

g.text: Strong specialized controls are included in Figure 3. Mean bars are lossy distributional controls.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #647683

g.text: Winning under a decoder does not establish human preference.
